properties.description: Southside Green is the Green that runs from the top of the 7th Heaven Express Chairlift, zig zags down the front of this area and then exits to the right towards the top of the Jersey Cream Express Chairlift.
properties.name: Southside Green

properties.description: Hugh’s Heaven is a big, wide, steep, groomed Blue that runs down through 7th Heaven area. It starts at the same bend in Greenline (Green) where Cloud Nine starts, runs parallel to Cloud Nine and ends at the bottom of the 7th Heaven Express Chairlift.
properties.name: Hugh's Heaven

properties.description: Wishbone is a medium wide Blue that runs from below Rendezvous Lodge down towards the bottom of Jersey Cream Express Chairlift.
properties.name: Wishbone

properties.description: Jersey Cream Run is one of the 2 main Blues that run down from the top of Jersey Cream Express Chairlift down to the bottom of the chairlift.
properties.name: Jersey Cream

properties.description: The Blackcomb Glacier Traverse runs across the top of the Blackcomb Glacier and provides access to runs into the bowl as well to routes at the far East end that exit the area (e.g. the Spearhead Traverse).
properties.name: Blackcomb Glacier Traverse

properties.description: Showcase is a wide, steep Blue that runs down from the top of the Showcase T-Bar, down the upper middle of the Horstman Glacier and then ends on Crystal Traverse (Blue) at the bottom of the Showcase T-bar.
properties.name: Showcase

properties.description: Horstman Face is a steep, challenging Double Black that drops down behind the Horstman Hut into the Glacier Express Chairlift area.
properties.name: Horstman Face

properties.description: Glacier Drive is Black that starts behind Horstman Hut, runs down the middle of the Glacier Express Chairlift area and ends down at the bottom of the chairlift next to the Glacier Creek Lodge.   The top part of this run used to be called Blue Line.
properties.name: Glacier Drive

properties.description: Rock’n’Roll - Upper starts on the right side of Trapline - Upper and runs down to join Backstage pass further downhill.
properties.name: Rock N'Roll - Upper

properties.description: Easy Out is a long winding Green that curves back and forth across the left side (looking downhill) of the upper frontside of Blackcomb and ends on Greenline (green) just above the Blackcomb Gondola Mid Station.
properties.name: Easy Out

properties.description: Raptor’s Ride is the longest of the 4, bumpy Black glade runs that start on Expressway (Green) and lead down to Sunset Boulevard (Green).   The trees on this run are well spaced and with fresh snow this can be a wonderful fluffy bump glade run!
properties.name: Raptor's Ride

properties.description: Similar to Raptor’s Ride and Watch Out, Where’s Joe is a shorter bumpy black glade that starts on Expressway (Green) and leads down to Sunset Boulevard (Green).
properties.name: Where's Joe

properties.description: Watch Out is similar to Raptor’s Ride (Black) and is another bumpy Black glade run that starts on Expressway (Green) and leads down to Sunset Boulevard (Green).
properties.name: Watch Out

properties.description: Yard Sale is the final and shortest of the 4 bumpy Black glade runs that start on Expressway (Green) and leads down to Sunset Boulevard (Green)
properties.name: Yard Sale

properties.description: Sunburn is a Black mogul run and is the sibling of Angel Dust (Black).   Access to the top of Sunburn and Angel Dust (which start at the same point) is from the right side (looking downhill) of Hugh’s Heaven.   It goes down to the bottom of the 7th Heaven
properties.name: Sunburn

properties.description: The Everglades is a wide area of Black glade skiing that runs from Greenline (Green) above down to 7th Avenue (Green) below.
properties.name: Everglades

properties.description: 7th Avenue is a long, narrow, relatively flat Green that runs from near the top of the Jersey Cream Express Chairlift, around the side of mountain and down to the lower sections of the 3 big Blues in the 7th Heaven area, ending on Cloud Nine (Blue).
properties.name: 7th Avenue

properties.description: Catskinner is a wide, steep Black run that is normally groomed but often is left to become a mogul run.  It starts on the right side of Expressway (Green) and runs down to join Easy Out (Green)
properties.name: Catskinner

properties.description: The Saudan Couloir run is the world famous, steep Double Black that runs down the center of the Saudan Couloir and ends down in the Jersey Cream Bowl.
properties.name: Saudan Couloir

properties.description: The Blackcomb Terrain Park starts just below the top of the Catskinner Chairlift and includes medium, large and extra large features and is designed for intermediate and expert park skiers.
properties.name: Blackcomb Terrain Park Intermediate Zone

properties.description: Wishbone Connector is a short Blue connector run from the top of the Catskinner Chairlift and Blackcomb Gondola over to Wishbone.
properties.name: Wishbone Connector

properties.description: Springboard is a big, wide blue with steep sections.  It starts just below the top of the Blackcomb Gondola, runs down to and crosses Greenline (Green) and then continues down between Cruiser (Blue) and Stoker (Blue) to end on Greenline.
properties.name: Springboard

properties.description: Ross’s Gold is a wide Blue with steep sections that starts below Rendezvous Lodge on the left side of Wishbone (Blue) and runs down to Greenline (Green).  NOTE: This run is regularly used for ski race training and so is often closed to the public.
properties.name: Ross's Gold

properties.description: Jersey Cream Run is one of the 2 main Blues that run down from the top of Jersey Cream Express Chairlift down to the bottom of the chairlift.
properties.name: Jersey Cream

properties.description: Cloud Nine is a big, wide, steep Blue that run down through the 7th Heaven. It starts at the first bend in Greenline (Green) where it comes down from the top of 7th Heaven Express Chairlift and ends down at the bottom of the 7th Heaven Express Chairlift.
properties.name: Cloud Nine

properties.description: Panorama is a big, steep Blue on 7th Heaven.  It starts at the 2nd bend of Greeline (Green), curves under the 7th Heaven Express Chairlift and ends at the bottom of the 7th Heaven Express Chairlift.
properties.name: Panorama

properties.description: Buzz Cut is medium wide Blue with some steeper sections that runs from Wishbone (Blue), past the top of the Excelerator Express Chairlift and then down to Greenline (Green).
properties.name: Buzz Cut

properties.description: Ridge Runner is one of the main Blues that runs from the top of the Crystal Express Chairlift down through the Crystal Ridge area and ends on Blackcomb Glacier Road (Blue).
properties.name: Ridge Runner

properties.description: Davies Dervish is a steep, wide Black mogul run the starts on Blue Line (Blue) and then continues down to the Glacier Express Chairlift base area.
properties.name: Davies Dervish

properties.description: Zig Zag is a medium wide Blue with some steep sections that starts at the Glacier Creek Lodge area and runs down to Blackcomb Glacier Road (near the bottom of the Excelerator Express Chairlift).
properties.name: Zig Zag

properties.description: Crosscut is a Green cat track run from the top of the Excelerator Express Chairlift over to the Glacier Creek Lodge area.
properties.name: Crosscut

properties.description: Espresso is made up of several ungroomed, bumpy Blue sections under the Excelerator Express Chairlift.
properties.name: Espresso

properties.description: Zig Zag is a medium wide Blue with some steep sections that starts at the Glacier Creek Lodge area and runs down to Blackcomb Glacier Road (near the bottom of the Excelerator Express Chairlift).
properties.name: Zig Zag

properties.description: Honeycomb is medium wide Blue that starts on Wishbone just past where Cruiser (Blue) starts.  It runs parallel to Cruiser down the frontside and ends where the Blackcomb Glacier Road (Blue) and Greenline (Green) meet just above the bottom Excelerator.
properties.name: Honeycomb

properties.description: The Everglades is a wide area of Black glade skiing that runs from Greenline (Green) above down to 7th Avenue (Green) below.
properties.name: Everglades

properties.description: The Everglades is a wide area of Black glade skiing that runs from Greenline (Green) above down to 7th Avenue (Green) below.
properties.name: Everglades

properties.description: Rider’s Revenge is a short Black glade run.  It starts on the right side of Crystal Road (Green) near the end of Trapline (Blue) and ends down on Crystal Glide (Blue).
properties.name: Rider's Revenge

properties.description: Backstage Pass is medium wide Blue with some steep sections.   Normally groomed, it can also offer some nice fresh tracks on a new snow day.  It starts on the right side of Rock’n’Roll (Blue), runs parallel with it and then curves off to the right to join
properties.name: Backstage Pass

properties.description: Dakine is a Black mogul field below the Glacier Express Chairlift.  It starts on the left side (looking downhill) of Crystal Traverse, goes down under the chairlift and then runs down parallel to Blue Line.
properties.name: Dakine

properties.description: Upper Straight Shot is a Black mogul runs that start from Crystal Road (Green) just below the Crystal Hut.  It runs parallel to White Light (Blue) and ends on Blueline (Blue).
properties.name: Upper Straight Shot

properties.description: Dave’s Day Off is a bumpy, off-piste Black run that goes down the middle of Brownlie Bowl (Black).
properties.name: Dave's Day Off

properties.description: Overbite is a long, steep, wide Black mogul run the starts on Crystal Traverse (Blue), runs down to and crosses Blue Line (Blue) and then continues down to the Glacier Express Chairlift base area.
properties.name: Overbite

properties.description: The Bite is the most difficult steep Black big mogul run from Coyote Road down to the Jersey Cream Express Chairlift base.   This run is recognizable for the very large boulder in the middle of the lower half of the run.
properties.name: The Bite

properties.description: Lower Straight Shot is a Blue run that starts on Blue Line (Blue), runs down to cross Blue Line further down the mountain and Crystal Road (Green) and then ends at the bottom near the end of Trapline (Blue).
properties.name: Lower Straight Shot

properties.description: White Light is a Blue mogul run with some steep sections.  It starts just below the top of the Crystal Ridge Express Chairlift, crosses Blue Line (Blue) and Crystal Road (Green) and ends below Crystal Glide (Blue).
properties.name: White Light

properties.description: Crystal Glide is the lower access route into the Crystal Ridge area.  This Blue run starts at the Glacier Creek Lodge area and continues down to the bottom of the Crystal Express Chairlift.
properties.name: Crystal Glide

properties.description: Staircase is a steep, challenging Black big mogul run that comes down from Coyote Road and ends on Wishbone (Blue).
properties.name: Staircase

properties.description: Blowdown is a bumpy Black run from Coyote Road down to Wishbone (Blue).   You can access it by turning right off of Jersey Cream Run (Blue) on to Coyote Road and then turning left onto Blowdown.
properties.name: Blowdown

properties.description: Sluiceway is a short Blue run that starts on the side of Cloud Nine and exits back on to Cloud Nine further down the hill.
properties.name: Sluiceway

properties.description: Secret Bowl run is steep, wide Black mogul run that comes out of Secret Bowl through an opening in the cliff face and then runs down to Blueline (Blue) below.
properties.name: Secret Bowl Run
properties.piste:name: Secret Chute

properties.description: Cougar Chutes is a steep Black run that starts at the very end of Secret Bowl and runs down into the Jersey Cream Express Chairlift area below.
properties.name: Cougar Chutes
properties.piste:name: Cougar Chute

properties.description: Xhiggy’s Meadow is a steep, bumpy Black slope just below the start of the Lakeside Bowl Traverse and to the left of Cloud Nine (Blue).  Exit out of the bottom of Xhiggy’s is on to Cloud Nine.
properties.name: Xhiggy's Meadow
properties.piste:name: Xhiggy's Meadow

properties.description: Bark Sandwich is a longer, difficult Black glade run that starts on Expressway (Green), runs parallel to Catskinner run (Black) downhill and ends on Easy Out (Green).
properties.name: Bark Sandwich

properties.description: Pakalolo is steep, bumpy Double Black that starts with a chute at the top just below Secret Bowl and turns into a steep mogul field that leads down to Blue Line (Blue).
properties.name: Pakalolo
properties.piste:name: Pakalolo

properties.description: Quasar is the the easier (but still challenging), steep Black route down into the Saudan Couloir.  It starts to the right of the Saudan Couloir (Double Black), curves to the right side of the moraine and ends in the top of the Jersey Cream Bowl.
properties.name: Quasar
properties.piste:name: Quasar

properties.description: Ruby Bowl is a big, steep, bumpy Double Black bowl.   To access Ruby Bowl, traverse left across from the top of Spanky’s Ladder and then take either Spanky’s Shoulder (Black) or Spanky’s Chute (Double Black) into Ruby Bowl.
properties.name: Ruby Bowl
properties.piste:name: Ruby Bowl

properties.description: Diamond Bowl is a large, steep, bumpy, ungroomed alpine bowl that then leads down to Blackcomb Glacier Road (Blue) below

Blue Line starts at the top of the ridge behind Horstman Hut curves down into the Horstman Glacier Bowl, runs down the middle of the Glacier Express Chairlift area and then curves down and behind the Glacier Creek Lodge.
properties.name: Blue Line

properties.description: The Blowhole is a famous, unique Black feature on the left side of the glacier.  It gets its shape from the winds howling over the ridge and looks like a long halfpipe.
properties.name: Blow Hole

properties.description: Garnet Bowl right is the route to skiers' right (looking downhill) of Garnet Bowl.  It provides access the Sapphire Bowl Entrance Chutes as well as a traverse into Diamond Bowl.
properties.name: Garnet Bowl Right

properties.description: Expressway is a long, narrow, relatively flat Green that runs from near the top of the Catskinner Chairlift / Rendezvous Lodge area, around the mountain and down to the bottom of the 7th Heaven Express Chairlift.
properties.name: Expressway

properties.description: Expressway is a long, narrow, relatively flat Green that runs from near the top of the Catskinner Chairlift / Rendezvous Lodge area, around the mountain and down to the bottom of the 7th Heaven Express Chairlift.
properties.name: Expressway

properties.description: Cruiser is steep-ish Blue that starts on the right side (looking downhill) of Wishbone (Blue) and then curves to the bottom of the Jersey Cream Express Chairlift Express Chairlift.
properties.name: Cougar Milk

properties.description: Chainsaw Ridge is an unmarked, off-piste Black route that runs down beside the cliff edge on the right (looking uphill) of the Saudan Couloir.
properties.name: Chainsaw Ridge

properties.description: False Face is an extremely steep Triple Black face that drops into the Saudan Couloir to the left of the Saudan Couloir run.
properties.name: False Face

properties.description: Hawaii 5-0 is an extremely steep, curved Triple Black chute that leads into Saudan Couloir.  Entrance to “5-0” (as the locals call it) into the top of the chute is over a cornice along the edge of Chainsaw Ridge (Black).
properties.name: Hawaii 5-0

properties.description: Sunrise Traverse is a narrow, rocky and dangerous Double Black traverse that goes from the right side of Quasar (Black) over to the top of a cliff to the top of Sunrise Chute (Double Black).
properties.name: Sunrise Traverse

properties.description: Sunrise Chute is a narrow, steep, rocky Double Black chute accessible at the top from Sunrise Traverse (Triple Black).
properties.name: Sunrise Chute

properties.description: Upper Feather Tree is a steep, rocky Double Black face on the right side of the Saudan Couloir that leads down into the upper end of couloir.
properties.name: Upper Feathertree

properties.description: Cougar Chutes is a steep Black run that starts at the very end of Secret Bowl and runs down into the Jersey Cream Express Chairlift area below.
properties.name: Secret Bowl Traverse

properties.description: Lower Feather Tree is the steep, wide slope on the right side of the lower side of the Saudan Couloir and above the Jersey Cream Bowl.   You can access Upper Feather Tree (Double Black) via a traverse on the right 1/3rd the way down Quasar (Double Black).
properties.name: Lower Feather Tree Traverse

properties.description: Lower Feather Tree is the steep, wide slope on the right side of the lower side of the Saudan Couloir and above the Jersey Cream Bowl.   You can access Upper Feather Tree (Double Black) via a traverse on the right 1/3rd the way down Quasar (Double Black).
properties.name: Lower Feather Tree

properties.description: Bushrat is steep, challenging Triple Black chute into the Saudan Couloir between Hawaii 5-0 (Triple Black) and Bushwip (Triple Black) along the side Chainsaw Ridge (Black).  The entrance into this chute is from Chainsaw ridge and then over a cornice.
properties.name: Bushrat

properties.description: Bushrat Shoulder is steep, challenging Triple Black that runs parallel to and just below Bushrat.  The entrance from Chainsaw Ridge (Black) is the same as Bushrat, but then Bushrat Shoulder runs along a bench between the cliffs below Bushrat.
properties.name: Bushrat Shoulder

properties.description: Whiplash is a Triple Black entrance into the Saudan Couloir   Entrance is over a cornice which then leads down into a steep, rocky chute down into the Bowl.
properties.name: Whiplash

properties.description: Bushwip is a Triple Black chute into the Saudan Couloir below.  The entrance into this run is from Chainsaw Ridge and over a cornice down into a steep, rocky chute.
properties.name: Bushwip

properties.description: Upper Jersey Cream Bowl Wall - This the wall below the lower end of Chainsaw Ridge, near the top of Jersey Cream Express Chairlift.   There are several different Black and Double Black routes down this wall along its face.
properties.name: Hot Tub

properties.description: Upper Jersey Cream Bowl Wall - This the wall below the lower end of Chainsaw Ridge, near the top of Jersey Cream Express Chairlift.   There are several different Black and Double Black routes down this wall along its face.
properties.name: Regulator

properties.description: Upper Jersey Cream Bowl Wall - This the wall below the lower end of Chainsaw Ridge, near the top of Jersey Cream Express Chairlift.   There are several different Black and Double Black routes down this wall along its face.
properties.name: Low Test

properties.description: Upper Jersey Cream Bowl Wall - This the wall below the lower end of Chainsaw Ridge, near the top of Jersey Cream Express Chairlift.   There are several different Black and Double Black routes down this wall along its face.
properties.name: High Test

properties.description: Upper Jersey Cream Bowl Wall - This the wall below the lower end of Chainsaw Ridge, near the top of Jersey Cream Express Chairlift.   There are several different Black and Double Black routes down this wall along its face.
properties.name: Dogleg

properties.description: Last Resort is a long, narrow Green that starts in the 7th Heaven area and runs into the Catskinner Chair area where it joins with Easy Out (Green).
properties.name: Last Resort

properties.description: The Lakeside Traverse is a long traverse under the cliffs, across the top of the Lakeside Bowl.  It provides access to a variety of routes into the bowl.
properties.name: Lakeside Traverse

properties.description: Lakeside Bowl is large Black alpine bowl on the right side of the 7th Heaven area.  Access to this area is via the Lakeside Bowl Traverse. There are a variety of routes that lead down into the bowl which then exit out on to Cloud Nine (Blue) below.
properties.name: Lakeside Bowl

properties.description: Lakeside Bowl is large Black alpine bowl on the right side of the 7th Heaven area.  Access to this area is via the Lakeside Bowl Traverse. There are a variety of routes that lead down into the bowl which then exit out on to Cloud Nine (Blue) below.
properties.name: Lakeside Bowl

properties.description: Lakeside Bowl is large Black alpine bowl on the right side of the 7th Heaven area.  Access to this area is via the Lakeside Bowl Traverse. There are a variety of routes that lead down into the bowl which then exit out on to Cloud Nine (Blue) below.
properties.name: Lakeside Bowl

properties.description: This a steep, narrow, rocky, difficult Triple Black that starts over a cornice, becomes a bench and then runs down on to the mogul field below Cougar Chutes and above Coyote Road.
properties.name: Purple Haze

properties.description: Pipeline is steep, narrow, rocky Double Black chute (located halfway between Secret Bowl and Pakalolo) that then curves down under a cliff to end on the mogul field below Pakalolo (Double Black).
properties.name: Pipeline

properties.description: The Curl / Lone Pine is a steep, narrow Triple Black that starts on the side of Secret Bowl and runs down a bench underneath a cliff to the wall above Blue Line (Blue).
properties.name: The Curl / Lone Pine

properties.description: Swiss Cheese is steep Black run that runs diagonally down the face below the top part of Secret Bowl.   It starts at the top from Secret Bowl and then runs down to end on Blueline (Blue).
properties.name: Swiss Cheese

properties.description: Clean Out is a short, steep Black chute entrance into the side of Secret Bowl Run (Black).  It starts at the top from Secret Bowl and ends on Secret Bowl Run.
properties.name: Clean Out

properties.description: The Chimney Ladder is a lesser known and used boot hike  to get up on the ridge above Crystal Traverse (Blue).  You can access the bottom of this ladder by following the Chimney Ladder Traverse above Crystal Traverse (Blue).
properties.name: Chimney Ladder Taverse

properties.description: The Grey Zone is a Black area of ungroomed, rocky open alpine above Crystal Traverse (Blue).   It starts at the top of the Chimney Ladder and runs down to the top of Crystal Ridge Express Chairlift.
properties.name: Grey Zone

properties.description: The Chimney Ladder is a lesser known and used boot hike  to get up on the ridge above Crystal Traverse (Blue).  You can access the bottom of this ladder by following the Chimney Ladder Traverse above Crystal Traverse (Blue).
properties.name: Chimney Ladder

properties.description: Brownlie Basin is a bumpy, cone shaped Black bowl below Crystal Traverse (Blue) that ends down on Blue Line (Blue).  You can drop into this Bowl at various points along the edge of Crystal Traverse.
properties.name: Brownlie Basin

properties.description: The Grey Zone is a Black area of ungroomed, rocky open alpine above Crystal Traverse (Blue).   It starts at the top of the Chimney Ladder and runs down to the top of Crystal Ridge Express Chairlift.
properties.name: Grey Zone

properties.description: Smoked Salmon is a short, steep Black glade run that starts on Crystal Traverse (Blue), curves down through the trees and ends on Blueline (Blue).
properties.name: Smoked Salmon

properties.description: Don’t Stop is a short, steep Black glade run that is a sibling to Smoked Salmon (Black).  This run also starts on Crystal Traverse (Blue), curves down through the trees and ends on Smoked Salmon.
properties.name: Don't Stop

properties.description: Luger's Run is an unmarked Black that runs underneath the Peak 2 Peak Gondola between Expressway (Green) at the top and Sunset Boulevard at the bottom.   This is a challenge bumpy, off-piste run with glade sections.
properties.name: Luger's Run

properties.description: The Baggers is a Black area of boulder strewn open alpine with some trees above Coyote Road and below Cougar Chutes (Black).
properties.name: Bagger 1

properties.description: The Baggers is a Black area of boulder strewn open alpine with some trees above Coyote Road and below Cougar Chutes (Black).
properties.name: Bagger 2

properties.description: The Baggers is a Black area of boulder strewn open alpine with some trees above Coyote Road and below Cougar Chutes (Black).
properties.name: Bagger 3

properties.description: CBC Trees is an unmarked Double Black glade area below Ridge Runner (Blue).  The entrance into this area is by a traverse from the right side near the top of Ridge Runner and the exit is on to Outer Limits (Double Black).
properties.name: CBC Trees

properties.description: Mellow and slightly gladed moguls beneath Fraggle Rock, labelled "Lower Fraggle Rock" on a sign at the main entrance from Rock N' Roll
properties.name: Side Bottom

properties.description: Fraggle Rock is a steep, unmarked area that runs down the face of a small summit underneath and near the top of the Crystal Ridge Express Chairlift.  It starts from Rock’n’Roll (Blue) and requires a short hike or skate to get up the back of the summit.
properties.name: Fraggle Rock

properties.description: The Everglades is a wide area of Black glade skiing that runs from Greenline (Green) above down to 7th Avenue (Green) below.
properties.name: Everglades

properties.description: The 7th Heaven Avenue Glades is an area of unmarked, tight, Black glades that run from 7th Heaven Avenue (Green) down to Expressway (Green) or to Easy Out (Green).
properties.name: 7th Heaven Avenue Glades

properties.description: The 7th Heaven Avenue Glades is an area of unmarked, tight, Black glades that run from 7th Heaven Avenue (Green) down to Expressway (Green) or to Easy Out (Green).
properties.name: 7th Heaven Avenue Glades

properties.description: Coyote Road is a flat, unmarked Blue that runs from the side of Jersey Cream Run (Blue) over to Blue Line (Blue).
properties.name: Coyote Road

properties.description: The Wind Lip is an ungroomed Black that leads down the right side (looking downhill) of the glacier and ends in the bottom of the bowl.
properties.name: Wind Lip

properties.description: Winky Pop is a short Black that goes over a rock ledge below Surf’s Up.  Winky Pop is accessible by traversing to the left (looking downhill) below and the Blow Hole (Black).
properties.name: Winky Pop

properties.description: Surf’s Up is a narrow, steep, difficult Double Black chute accessible from left side (looking downhill) of Winky Pop (Black).
properties.name: Surf's Up

properties.description: The Sapphire Bowl Entrances are a series of Double Black chute entrances from Garnet Bowl at the top down into the Sapphire Bowl below.
properties.name: Low Entry

properties.description: The Sapphire Bowl Entrances are a series of Double Black chute entrances from Garnet Bowl at the top down into the Sapphire Bowl below.
properties.name: Main Entry

properties.description: The Sapphire Bowl Entrances are a series of Double Black chute entrances from Garnet Bowl at the top down into the Sapphire Bowl below.
properties.name: 2M Gully

properties.description: The Sapphire Chutes are three very difficult, Double Black Chutes along the bottom edge of Sapphire Bowl.   They exit out down to Blackcomb Glacier Road below
properties.name: Sapphire Chutes

properties.description: The Sapphire Chutes are three very difficult, Double Black Chutes along the bottom edge of Sapphire Bowl.   They exit out down to Blackcomb Glacier Road below
properties.name: Sapphire Chutes

properties.description: The Sapphire Chutes are three very difficult, Double Black Chutes along the bottom edge of Sapphire Bowl.   They exit out down to Blackcomb Glacier Road below
properties.name: Sapphire Chutes

properties.description: Family Jewels is a steep Double Black that runs down the left side (looking downhill) of Sapphire Bowl and exits down on to Blackcomb Glacier (Blue).
properties.name: Family Jewels

properties.description: Zut Zut is challenging Double Black that starts from the left side of Family Jewels (Double Black), curves down to the left (looking downhill) and runs diagonally down across a bench between cliffs above and below.  It exits into Diamond Bowl.
properties.name: Zut Zut

properties.description: The Garnet Bowl is the small Black bowl immediate below the top of Spanky’s Ladder and above Diamond Bowl.
properties.name: Garnet Bowl

properties.description: Diamond Bowl is the lower, middle of 3 Gemstone Bowls.  It sits directly below Garnet Bowl (which is directly below the Spanky’s Ladder entrance into this area).
properties.name: Diamond Bowl

properties.description: Wild Thing is a steep Double Black chute entrance down the cliffs on the right side (looking downhill) of Diamond Bowl.
properties.name: Wild Thing

properties.description: Garnet Bowl Centre is the Black route down the middle / center of Garnet Bowl.  It provides access to the main entrance into Diamond Bowl.
properties.name: Garnet Bowl Center

properties.description: Diamond Bowl Left Entrance (Helter Skelter) is the 2nd entrance into Diamond Bowl and is a narrow chute above the large cliff on the left side (looking downhill) of the bowl.
properties.name: Diamond Bowl Left Entrance (Helter Skelter)

properties.description: Hobbs is actually 2 separate rocky Double Black chutes that go down through a lower cliff face on the left side (looking downhill) of Diamond Bowl.
properties.name: Hobbs (Left)

properties.description: Hobbs is actually 2 separate rocky Double Black chutes that go down through a lower cliff face on the left side (looking downhill) of Diamond Bowl.
properties.name: Hobbs (Right)

properties.description: Calvin is a short Double Black face below the Diamond Bowl Left Entrance (Double Black).  You can access the top of Calvin traversing and climbing up to the left just below the narrow Diamond Bowl Left Entrance (Helter Skelter) into Diamond Bowl.
properties.name: Calvin

properties.description: Bad Attitude is an extremely difficult, Triple Black chute (with a very fitting name) that leads down to a sloping bench between big cliffs above and below.  It is accessible via a very difficult, rocky traverse from the top of Clavin (Double Black).
properties.name: Bad Attitude
properties.piste:name: Bad Attitude

properties.description: Bad Attitude Traverse is a very difficult, rocky traverse from the top of Calvin (Double Black) to the start of Bad Attitude (Triple Black).
properties.name: Bad Attitude Traverse

properties.description: Playland is a tight, steep Double Black gully that runs down below a cliff along the right side (looking downhill) of Ruby Bowl.   You can access Playland by going right below the cliffs at the bottom of Skid Lips (Double Black).
properties.name: Playland

properties.description: Skid Lips is a steep Double Black that runs along the shoulder of a cliff along the right side of Ruby Bowl below Spanky’s Shoulder (Double Black).
properties.name: Skid Lips
properties.piste:name: Skid Lips

properties.description: Garnet Bowl Left is a Black route through the left side (looking downhill) of Garnet Bowl.   It provides access to the left entrance into Diamond Bowl as well as runs into Ruby Bowl.
properties.name: Garnet Bowl Left
properties.piste:name: Garnet Bowl

properties.description: Spanky’s Chute is a challenging, steep, narrow Double Black chute that leads into the top of Ruby Bowl.
properties.name: Spanky's Chute

properties.description: The Ruby Bowl Traverse is a long traverse along the ridge above Ruby Bowl.   It provides access to Spanky's Chute (Double Black) which leads down into Ruby Bowl.
properties.name: Ruby Bowl Traverse

properties.description: Shredder is a steep Double Black and is the furthest left route (looking downhill) down Ruby Bowl.
properties.name: Shredder
properties.piste:name: Shredder

properties.description: Midway Rock a steep Double Black route down the left side (looking downhill) of Ruby Bowl.  It is named after the Midway Rock cliff face that runs across the middle of Ruby Bowl.
properties.name: Midway Rock
properties.piste:name: Midway Rock

properties.description: Traverse across the top of Ruby Bowl.
properties.name: Ruby Bowl Traverse
properties.piste:name: Ruby Bowl Traverse

properties.description: The Diamond Bowl Main Entrance is the central entrance down from Garnet Bowl into the Diamond Bowl below.  This entrance is a steep, rocky chute, approach with caution.
properties.name: Diamond Centre

properties.description: The Race Center is fenced of portion of Cougar Milk (Blue)  which has a small ski race course on it.   It runs down the left Cougar Milk (looking downhill) and ends on the right Wally's World.
properties.name: Race Center

properties.description: The Race Center is fenced of portion of Cougar Milk (Blue)  which has a small ski race course on it.   It runs down the left Cougar Milk (looking downhill) and ends on the right Wishbone (Blue) run.
properties.name: Jersey Cream Race Center

properties.description: Hooker Hump is an unmarked “run” the follows along below the Jersey Cream Express Chairlift as it goes over a hump below and beside Jersey Cream Run (Blue).
properties.name: Hooker Hump

properties.description: Hooker Hump is an unmarked “run” the follows along below the Jersey Cream Express Chairlift as it goes over a hump below and beside Jersey Cream Run (Blue).
properties.name: Hooker Hump

properties.description: K Bumps is a short set of Black moguls on the far left side of the Jersey Cream cliffs.  You can access this run from the right side of Wishbone (Blue).
properties.name: K Bumps

properties.description: Diamond Bowl is a large, steep, bumpy, ungroomed alpine bowl that then leads down to Blackcomb Glacier Road (Blue) below
properties.name: Diamond Bowl

properties.description: This is a short access path from the Peak 2 Peak Gondola over to Catskinner area and Expressway.
properties.name: Expressway Access

properties.description: Jersey Cream Wall is a bumpy Black face below the top of Jersey Cream Express Chairlift.  It has less steep on the right (looking downhill) and more steep on the left (looking downhill) sections.
properties.name: Jersey Cream wall

properties.description: Jersey Cream Wall is a bumpy Black face below the top of Jersey Cream Express Chairlift.  It has less steep on the right (looking downhill) and more steep on the left (looking downhill) sections.
properties.name: Jersey Cream Wall

properties.description: Jersey Cream Wall is a bumpy Black face below the top of Jersey Cream Express Chairlift.  It has less steep on the right (looking downhill) and more steep on the left (looking downhill) sections.
properties.name: Jersey Cream Wall

properties.description: Jersey Cream Run is one of the 2 main Blues that run down from the top of Jersey Cream Express Chairlift down to the bottom of the chairlift.
properties.name: Jersey Cream

properties.description: Tree Fall Chute is a small Black chute squeezed between the trees on the far left (looking downhill) of the Jersey Cream cliffs.   You can access this chute from the right side of Wishbone (Blue).
properties.name: Tree Fall

properties.description: The Spoon is the small Black bowl just to the right (looking downhill) of Jersey Cream cliffs.   You can access this bowl from the right side of Wishbone (Blue).
properties.name: The Spoon

properties.description: Pumphouse Roll is the small Black roll just to the right (looking downhill) of Jersey Cream cliffs.   You can access this roll from the right side of Wishbone (Blue).
properties.name: Pumphouse Roll

properties.description: Cafe Chute is the small, steep Black chute in the middle of the Jersey Cream cliffs.
Cafe Chute is the small, steep Black chute in the middle of the Jersey Cream cliffs.
properties.name: Cafe Chute

properties.description: Cougar Connector is a short Blue connector run between Jersey Cream and Cougar Milk.
properties.name: Cougar Milk Connector

properties.description: Cougar Chutes is a steep Black run that starts at the very end of Secret Bowl and runs down into the Jersey Cream Express Chairlift area below.
properties.name: Cougar Chutes

properties.description: Cougar Chutes is a steep Black run that starts at the very end of Secret Bowl and runs down into the Jersey Cream Express Chairlift area below.
properties.name: Cougar Chutes

properties.description: Wally's World is a Blue that runs from the Jersey Cream Run, runs parallel to Wishbone and ends and the bottom of the Jersey Cream Express Chairlift.
properties.name: Wally World

properties.description: Wishbone is a medium wide Blue that runs from below Rendezvous Lodge down towards the bottom of Jersey Cream Express Chairlift.
properties.name: Wishbone

properties.description: Wishbone is a medium wide Blue that runs from below Rendezvous Lodge down towards the bottom of Jersey Cream Express Chairlift.  It gets its name because it splits into 2 runs (like a chicken wishbone) around several forest “islands”.
properties.name: Wishbone

properties.description: Quasar is the the easier (but still challenging), steep Black route down into the Saudan Couloir.  It starts to the right of the Saudan Couloir (Double Black), curves to the right side of the moraine and ends in the top of the Jersey Cream Bowl.
properties.name: Sylvain / Big Bang
properties.piste:name: Sylvain / Big Bang

properties.description: Upper Green Line is the Green that runs from the top of the 7th Heaven Express Chairlift, zig zags down the front of this area and then exits to the right towards the top of the Jersey Cream Express Chairlift.
properties.name: Upper Green Line

properties.description: Teetering is a very steep, challenging Triple Black Chute that  comes down from Secret Bowl into the Glacier Express Chairlift area.   It is named for the large rock that is "teetering" on the edge of the cliff next to it.
properties.name: Teetering

properties.description: Dakine is a Black mogul field below the Glacier Express Chairlift.  It starts on the left side (looking downhill) of Crystal Traverse, goes down under the chairlift and then runs down parallel to Blue Line.
properties.name: Dakine

properties.description: Showcase Traverse runs across the bottom end of the Horstman Glacier from the bottom of Horstman over to Crystal Traverse.
properties.name: Showcase Traverse

properties.description: Showcase Bowl is the alpine bowl on either side of Showcase run.
properties.name: Showcase Bowl

properties.description: Catskinner Traverse is a Green cat track run from the top the Excelerator Express Chairlift across the Blackcomb Upper Frontside over to the bottom of the Catskinner Express Chairlift.
properties.name: Catskinner Traverse

properties.description: Buzz Cut Connector is a short Blue that runs from Wally's World over to the top of the the Excelerator Express Chairlift and the start of Buzz Cut.
properties.name: Buzz Cut Connecter

properties.description: Jersey Cream Run is one of the 2 main Blues that run down from the top of Jersey Cream Express Chairlift down to the bottom of the chairlift.
properties.name: Jersey Cream

properties.description: Come a Long is a Green cat track run that starts on the side of Zig Zag near the Glacier Creek Lodge and runs diagonally down the Blackcomb Upper Front Side area to end on Green Line where it crosses Cruiser.
properties.name: Come a Long

properties.description: Wally's World is a Blue that runs from the Jersey Cream Run, runs parallel to Wishbone and ends and the bottom of the Jersey Cream Express Chairlift.
properties.name: Wally World

properties.description: Blackcomb Glacier is a large, wide glacial bowl with a Blue route that runs down the middle to the Blackcomb Glacier Road (Blue) at the bottom.
properties.name: Blackcomb Glacier

properties.description: Glacier Drive is Black that starts behind Horstman Hut, runs down the middle of the Glacier Express Chairlift area and ends down at the bottom of the chairlift next to the Glacier Creek Lodge.   The top part of this run used to be called Blue Line.
properties.name: Glacier Drive

properties.description: Double Rubble is an advanced chute accessible via the Sapphire Traverse. This run has some major exposure so be careful.
properties.name: Double Rubble

properties.description: Large Traverse from the Blowhole exit into Sapphire Bowl. Section of traverse above Double Rubble and Surf's Up is a no fall zone with extreme exposure. Follow the bottom of the permanently closed area to the top of Sapphire Bowl.
properties.name: Sapphire Traverse
